hub.title: CHAMP Donate Integrations
hub.html:
CHAMP Donate

Every way to take donations with CHAMP

Six page layouts and fourteen ways to put a CHAMP campaign in front of donors, each set up for real. Open any one to see it working, how it was set up, and the code to copy.

Page layouts

Six designs for the donation page itself. Each one is shown live for both demo charities.

ClassicMulti-step wizard with a wide banner and a donation summary.
See both live →
CompactSingle-page form under a compact banner.
See both live →
Image leftA tall photo on the left tells the story; the form sits on the right.
See both live →
Image rightThe form comes first, with the photo on the right.
See both live →
Hero bannerA thin, full-width banner above a centred form, with an optional goal thermometer.
See both live →
ImmersiveA full-screen photo with the form card floating over it.
See both live →

Share a link

Nothing to install. A tracked link to the campaign page that works in emails, posts, texts and print.

🔗
Donate linkA link to the campaign’s donation page. Nothing to install.Example: Christmas Appeal 2026
See it live →
📰
Newsletter buttonA branded Donate button for your next email newsletter.Example: Willowmere – Light Up a Life
See it live →
✉️
Email signatureA short “Support our work” link in every staff email.Example: Willowmere – Every Moment Matters
See it live →
▦
QR code for printA QR code that opens the donation page on a phone.Example: Lantern Walk 2026
See it live →
💬
Social media postA tracked link for Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn or X.Example: Willowmere – A Meadow of Memories
See it live →
📱
Text messageA link to send by SMS or WhatsApp.Example: Warm Meal Fund
See it live →
🔁
Monthly giving linkOpens the form with monthly giving already selected.Example: A Home for Every Family
See it live →

On your website

Paste a snippet once, and donors give without leaving your site, on a page or in a pop-up over it.

🧾
Form on a pageThe whole donation form sits on a page of your website.Example: Willowmere – Flowers for Comfort
See it live →
♥
Floating Donate buttonA Donate button in the corner that opens the form over the page.Example: Light a Lantern
See it live →
▁
Sticky barA slim bar slides up as visitors scroll.Example: Willowmere – Remembrance Sunflowers
See it live →
€
Amounts in your textAmounts in your copy open the form with that amount chosen.Example: Winter Coat Drive
See it live →
🔘
Your own Donate buttonsThe Donate buttons already on your site open the form.Example: Willowmere – Garden Walk 2026
See it live →
📖
Sticky bar after readingSlides up once a visitor has read 70% of the page.Example: Willowmere – Every Moment Matters
See it live →
🔔
Ask for an email on closeIf a visitor closes the form without giving, it asks for their email.Example: A Home for Every Family
See it live →

Not sure where to start?

Start with a Donate link: nothing to install, and it works in emails, QR codes, posts and texts. Add a website option when your web person can paste a snippet.

layouts.title: Classic layout
layouts.html:
← All CHAMP Donate integrations
Page layout

Classic

Multi-step wizard with a wide banner and a donation summary. Good for higher-value and flagship appeals.

Hero image

1600 × 600 px · 8:3 wide

Shown here

Both demo charities, embedded live on this page with Form on a page. Each embed is tracked in CHAMP as “JLM layouts – Form on a page”.

See it live

Lantern TrustChristmas Appeal 2026
Open full page ↗
Willowmere HospiceLight Up a Life
Open full page ↗

How to use this layout

  • In CHAMP, open the campaign and go to Settings → Donation page → Page layout, then choose Classic.
  • Add a hero image at 1600 × 600 px under Hero banner.
  • Save and Publish. The layout is used on the campaign’s own page and in every embed.

Embed code used

<iframe src="https://giving.pmsvault.com/DEMO/c/christmas-appeal-2026-realistic?embed=true&utm_source=integration&utm_medium=embed&utm_campaign=75kn7aw3" width="100%" height="700" title="Donation form" frameborder="0" allow="payment" data-champ-auto-height style="border:none;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);"></iframe>
<script src="https://giving.pmsvault.com/embed/champ-iframe.v1.js" async></script>

The stock snippet caps the form at 500px wide. For wide layouts like this one, remove max-width:500px so the full design shows.

← ImmersiveCompact →
